Located in Ballito, Durban South Africa 

Just 180m from Shakas Rock Beach, this large stylish upmarket holiday home is the perfect Ballito coastal escape 🌊🏡. With 7 spacious bedrooms plus a separate granny flat, it’s ideal for family getaways, group holidays, or luxury weekends by the sea. Enjoy the best of the North Coast with Thompson’s Bay nearby and shops just minutes away — comfort, space, and seaside living all in one unforgettable stay.

Enjoy this beautifully presented townhouse with stunning fairway views. Enter through the double garage directly into the spacious ground floor, where you'll find open plan living, dining and kitchen areas. Step out to the covered patio, wooden deck and private swimming pool. Upstairs, discover three generously sized bedrooms. The main suite enjoys prime views over multiple fairways and conversation area, while the two additional bedrooms share a full bathroom. Sunlight floods through the rooms, creating a bright and inviting atmosphere.

Indulge in the epitome of coastal luxury at this exquisite 4-bedroom, 3-bathroom home in the world-renowned Zimbali Coastal Estate. Designed with modern elegance and tranquility in mind, this sanctuary comfortably accommodates up to 6 adults and 2 children — perfect for family getaways or a stylish escape with friends.

Step inside and experience seamless open-plan living, where the lounge, dining, and kitchen flow together effortlessly — ideal for entertaining or relaxing in refined comfort. The state-of-the-art kitchen boasts premium appliances and generous counter space, while the outdoor dining terrace invites you to savor breathtaking moments in a picturesque setting.

Located in Dolphin Coast, Durban South Africa 

Just 15 minutes from the airport and 5 minutes from shops and fine dining, this luxurious coastal villa offers effortless elegance and breathtaking comfort.
Step into a sun-filled open-plan lounge, dining, and kitchen area that flows seamlessly onto a grand covered veranda — the perfect setting for golden-hour cocktails at the built-in bar, overlooking a spectacular 180° sea view.
Dine beneath the stars at a four-meter oak table, designed for long, leisurely meals in sophisticated style.
The gourmet kitchen comes fully equipped with modern conveniences including a dishwasher, washing machine, and tumble dryer.
Each of the four spacious en-suite bedrooms offers refined comfort — with convertible king beds to suit every guest.
Designed on one level for easy flow, the villa includes two private parking bays and a double garage for your convenience.
